Showcase

01 Generative AI & NLP

Legal Knowledge Graph RAG System

Built an end-to-end legal AI assistant that combines a Neo4j knowledge graph (264K nodes, 506K relationships) with Gemini 2.5 Flash to answer immigration case law questions. Pydantic-driven structured extraction turns raw court opinions into a typed graph — no hallucinated schema, no brittle parsing. Outperforms NaiveRAG and CBR-RAG by 15–17% on faithfulness, with a hybrid retrieval pipeline that blends vector search with Cypher-based multi-hop graph traversal.

  • Python
  • Neo4j
  • Graphiti
  • Gemini
  • Pydantic
  • LangChain
02 Systems / Hardware / Formal Methods

Parallel Interleave for MEC Decomposition

Reimplemented the Interleave algorithm for Maximal End Component decomposition in Storm — a state-of-the-art probabilistic model checker — with parallel execution. Hit 2–5x speedup over the sequential baseline across the full QVBS benchmark suite. Built a profiling pipeline from scratch: perf with DWARF call-graphs at 997 Hz, Valgrind instrumentation, flamegraph generation, and C++ template symbol demangling to make profilers actually see the right entry points.

  • C++
  • Python
  • Storm
  • perf
  • Valgrind

03 Generative AI & NLP

PopSign: AI Storybooks for ASL Learning

Designed a generative AI pipeline that authors ASL-constrained children's stories using Gemini — with a custom validation framework that drove lexical constraint violations to zero. Built an NLP evaluation system using Sentence-BERT, spaCy, and readability metrics to auto-classify story difficulty across Fountas-Pinnell levels A–Z, enabling data-driven curriculum design. An embedding-based vocabulary sampler (Embedding-Gemma) generates semantically coherent, level-appropriate word sets for each story.

  • Python
  • Gemini
  • Sentence-BERT
  • spaCy
  • Embedding-Gemma

04 Robotics & Reinforcement Learning

SpaceX Starship Lander

Modeled SpaceX's Starship in Unreal Engine 5 and trained a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning control system to land it on the pad. The agent learns from scratch in simulation — no hand-crafted controllers, no waypoints — using TensorFlow and the OpenAI Gym interface. The result is a system that handles the full descent-to-landing sequence autonomously.

  • TensorFlow
  • Unreal Engine 5
  • OpenAI Gym
  • Deep RL

05 Computer Vision

Surveillance Area Blind Spot Detection

Reconstructs a surveillance camera's field of view in 3D from raw images and video, then pinpoints the blind spots that coverage planning misses — pushing detection up by 20%. I built the full research stack, from structure-from-motion reconstruction to blind-spot identification, and layered in LIME explainability so the model's decisions stay transparent.
